title: Mavs, Magic make moves; Cavs, Hornets slide
heading: 2006-07 Power Rankings: Week 5
author: Marc Stein

rankings.summaryHtml: Bold prediction: Mavs won't be going 78-4. Simply matching the club's longest-ever winning streak (14) is two road wins away. But they're an undisputed No. 1, right?
rankings.summaryText: Bold prediction: Mavs won't be going 78-4. Simply matching the club's longest-ever winning streak (14) is two road wins away. But they're an undisputed No. 1, right?

rankings.summaryHtml: You can live with a 1-3 blip after a 12-1 start. Sloan's real issue is giving up two 50-point games in one month, which no NBA team had done since December 1990.
rankings.summaryText: You can live with a 1-3 blip after a 12-1 start. Sloan's real issue is giving up two 50-point games in one month, which no NBA team had done since December 1990.

rankings.summaryHtml: Best in the East? A tidy 6-2 against the West? On a 59-win pace? Twenty-nine wins in their last 40 games counting last season's 16-6 finish? It's early, yes, but it's all true.
rankings.summaryText: Best in the East? A tidy 6-2 against the West? On a 59-win pace? Twenty-nine wins in their last 40 games counting last season's 16-6 finish? It's early, yes, but it's all true.

rankings.summaryHtml: Not that they really need to look for silver linings, but Spurs are still unbeaten on the road with Manu in the lineup. So they're fine . . . as long as he's back soon.
rankings.summaryText: Not that they really need to look for silver linings, but Spurs are still unbeaten on the road with Manu in the lineup. So they're fine . . . as long as he's back soon.

rankings.summaryHtml: After Amare rumbles for at least 20-and-10 in four straight games, I think even the skeptics would agree: You'd welcome an 80-percent Amare on your team.
rankings.summaryText: After Amare rumbles for at least 20-and-10 in four straight games, I think even the skeptics would agree: You'd welcome an 80-percent Amare on your team.

rankings.summaryHtml: As stated last week: Who needs a smooth training camp? Not Kobe, who's shooting a career-best 49 percent from the floor and hushing all that It's A Clipper Town stuff.
rankings.summaryText: As stated last week: Who needs a smooth training camp? Not Kobe, who's shooting a career-best 49 percent from the floor and hushing all that It's A Clipper Town stuff.

rankings.summaryHtml: Losing their streak in Charlotte wasn't the best. But Pistons' 11-1 record in six back-to-back sets is quite good, with 16 back-to-backs to go for a league-high 22 overall.
rankings.summaryText: Losing their streak in Charlotte wasn't the best. But Pistons' 11-1 record in six back-to-back sets is quite good, with 16 back-to-backs to go for a league-high 22 overall.

rankings.summaryHtml: Rough week for T-Mac, who took painful shots to the hip and the head, but a healthy month for Rockets, who enjoyed their first 10-win November since 1996-97.
rankings.summaryText: Rough week for T-Mac, who took painful shots to the hip and the head, but a healthy month for Rockets, who enjoyed their first 10-win November since 1996-97.

rankings.summaryHtml: Nuggets can't get too broken up about a home loss to Grizz when 'Melo's an All-Star lock already, J.R. might be Steal of the Summer and they're even outscoring Phoenix.
rankings.summaryText: Nuggets can't get too broken up about a home loss to Grizz when 'Melo's an All-Star lock already, J.R. might be Steal of the Summer and they're even outscoring Phoenix.

rankings.summaryHtml: Disappointing as it was to lose a roadie at the buzzer to struggling Seattle, Pacers still have East's No. 4 record . . . when they've played only six home games.
rankings.summaryText: Disappointing as it was to lose a roadie at the buzzer to struggling Seattle, Pacers still have East's No. 4 record . . . when they've played only six home games.

rankings.summaryHtml: Bulls have endured the hardest schedule in the league so far, as well as a national headband debate, but none of that really has set them back. What a conference.
rankings.summaryText: Bulls have endured the hardest schedule in the league so far, as well as a national headband debate, but none of that really has set them back. What a conference.

rankings.summaryHtml: Wins over Jazz and Spurs were special, but Warriors just played 11 of 12 at home and went 7-5. So they're behind last season's 12-6 pace, with several roadies forthcoming.
rankings.summaryText: Wins over Jazz and Spurs were special, but Warriors just played 11 of 12 at home and went 7-5. So they're behind last season's 12-6 pace, with several roadies forthcoming.

rankings.summaryHtml: East aside, this is November's most disappointing team. Routing Orlando doesn't change the fact that Clips are 0-6 on the road and have sunk to last in the Pacific.
rankings.summaryText: East aside, this is November's most disappointing team. Routing Orlando doesn't change the fact that Clips are 0-6 on the road and have sunk to last in the Pacific.

rankings.summaryHtml: I know they miss Hughes. I know nights like Saturday in Houston happen to everyone. But a 6-7 record in the East? With losses to Bobcats, Hawks and Knicks?
rankings.summaryText: I know they miss Hughes. I know nights like Saturday in Houston happen to everyone. But a 6-7 record in the East? With losses to Bobcats, Hawks and Knicks?

rankings.summaryHtml: Artest (uh-oh) says he wants more shots. Bibby is gamely playing hurt but shooting 35.1 percent, 26.8 on 3s. Maybe, just maybe, Kings should look for K-Mart first.
rankings.summaryText: Artest (uh-oh) says he wants more shots. Bibby is gamely playing hurt but shooting 35.1 percent, 26.8 on 3s. Maybe, just maybe, Kings should look for K-Mart first.

rankings.summaryHtml: For all the talk about how little help D-Wade's getting with Shaq out, Heat really can't ask for more from Haslem, who's averaging a healthy 13.4 ppg and 9.7 rpg.
rankings.summaryText: For all the talk about how little help D-Wade's getting with Shaq out, Heat really can't ask for more from Haslem, who's averaging a healthy 13.4 ppg and 9.7 rpg.

rankings.summaryHtml: Losing West and Peja would be a killer at any time. But losing both frontcourt starters early is especially rough, with 17 of Hornets' first 30 games on the road.
rankings.summaryText: Losing West and Peja would be a killer at any time. But losing both frontcourt starters early is especially rough, with 17 of Hornets' first 30 games on the road.

rankings.summaryHtml: Not a good week overall, but an encouraging ending with Wolves' road win in Philly and my man Mike James, after a rough Nov., starting the new month strong.
rankings.summaryText: Not a good week overall, but an encouraging ending with Wolves' road win in Philly and my man Mike James, after a rough Nov., starting the new month strong.

rankings.summaryHtml: Figures. After my recent ode to J-Kidd in the Weekend Dime, he fails to score in double figures six times in seven games, five of them losses.
rankings.summaryText: Figures. After my recent ode to J-Kidd in the Weekend Dime, he fails to score in double figures six times in seven games, five of them losses.

rankings.summaryHtml: Woodson probably hasn't received enough credit for Hawks hovering around .500. But they'd be an even bigger story if they hadn't lost five games by five points or less.

rankings.summaryHtml: Raps already have been West twice and play almost half their road schedule before Jan. 1. So maybe there is one Atlantic team that can live with its start.

rankings.summaryHtml: Toughest week so far begins with news that Simmons might be out for the season. The response? Bucks stun Lakers and Warriors on the road and scare Suns, too.

rankings.summaryHtml: Arenas has been held to 10 points or less three times . . . and Wiz are still the East's (and the league's) worst road team at 0-8. It's bizarre, not quirky.
rankings.summaryText: Arenas has been held to 10 points or less three times . . . and Wiz are still the East's (and the league's) worst road team at 0-8. It's bizarre, not quirky.

rankings.summaryHtml: Memories from any of those first-round sweeps are almost pleasant compared to looking at box scores without Pau and all the uncertainty surrounding the team's sale.

rankings.summaryHtml: Surely you expected Bobs to beat Pistons and favor them to topple Spurs again Wednesday. They're 4-1 against CLE, SA, NJ and DET, 1-11 against all others.

rankings.summaryHtml: Just a hunch, but I'm struggling to picture the volatile Bob Hill -- seemingly railing about something new every day -- with Sonics next season. Wherever they are.

rankings.summaryHtml: Ouch. Sunday's loss to Hawks completed an 0-4 homestand for back-to-Earth, Roy-less Blazers, who are 2-10 since their 4-2 start and play their next six on the road.

rankings.summaryHtml: Only in Gotham could this news be bad news, but Knicks -- who even Isiah admits play with 'fear' at MSG -- have only one roadie in the next 10 games.

rankings.summaryHtml: On Wednesday AM, Celts led the Atlantic. By Friday PM, they had lost to Nets and Raps by a combined seven points. Now they have nine more road games this month.

rankings.summaryHtml: Anyone remember that 3-0 start, which included a win at Orlando? If it feels like forever ago, that's because Sixers have only two wins in the 27 days since.
